description: List district polygons of a city with canonical FlatHunt ids for the `areas` filter. Catalogs exist for cities where list_cities reports hasAreas (Berlin, the default, and more cities over time). Two levels: district (level 1 — Berlin Bezirk, Lisbon/Porto concelho, Milan municipio, Madrid distrito …) and neighbourhood (level 2 inside it — Ortsteil, freguesia, NIL, barrio …); `type` is the local unit name. For cities without a catalog search by city, post code or lat/lng/radiusKm. Returns id, name, slug, type, level and parent area, with optional name, level and type filters. Mitte exists both as a whole Bezirk (berlin:bezirk:mitte) and as a smaller Ortsteil (berlin:ortsteil:mitte). Charlottenburg is an Ortsteil; the parent Bezirk is Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf. Popular names that are not catalog units (Bairro Alto, Kreuzkölln) are not listed: pick the area that contains them or use lat/lng/radiusKm.

city.description: City id from list_cities (e.g. de-berlin, pt-lisbon). Omit for Berlin.

level.description: Optional filter: district = level 1 (Bezirk, concelho, municipio …), neighbourhood = level 2.

query.description: Optional case- and accent-insensitive substring filter on area name or slug. Omit to return the full catalog (Berlin: 109 areas).

type.description: Optional filter by local unit type (bezirk, ortsteil, concelho, freguesia, nil, barrio …).

name: list_areas
title: List districts catalog
